text:
Emma K: Kicking off thread for EduPlat POC scope — customer wants a 4 week pilot to validate grading assistant and search/similarity rerank. Quick sync: what are the must-have success criteria?
Raj P: Hi — from sales: acceptance = 95% answer coverage on rubric + <200ms p95 for gen flows. They care about SSO and data residency.
Zach L: Technical: confirm model context need. EduPlat says multi-doc student transcripts + syllabus — likely 64k context. Can we do 64k with tool calling?
Emma K: They also want a fallback to embeddings-based search when context > model window. Success criteria should include embedding recall @k and rerank NDCG.
Lisa M: Agree. Proposed POC milestones: week1 ingest & connectors, week2 prompt/eval creation, week3 perf tuning + quantized models, week4 handover + SLO test.
Raj P: Pricing Q: will they run on Hosted API or Dedicated? They asked for cost estimate for ~100k monthly active students (50k queries/day).
Zach L: Quick calc: if we use hosted gpt- style gen at 64k, token costs spike. Recommend Dedicated with reserved capacity for predictable unit cost — we should model batching and KV caching to drop tokens.
Emma K: For acceptance we'll need prompt sets. Can we ship a small eval harness so they can run quality checks? Example prompt format: ```
PROMPT: "Given student transcript and syllabus, generate feedback focusing on learning outcomes."
EVAL: pairwise A/B against baseline, measure helpfulness score 1-5
```
Lisa M: I'll draft 25 seed prompts + expected outputs. Also need embedding config: model, dim, similarity metric (cosine). They prefer rerank using embedding prefilter + cross-encoder rerank.
Zach L: Recommend embed model x-large for recall; store vectors in their VPC Postgres + PGVector. Rerank cross-encoder can be a smaller dedicated gen model for latency. tradeoffs: cost vs precision.
Emma K: Security: EduPlat's legal sent a questionnaire (PII, retention, KMS). @sec-bot can you confirm what templates we have for KMS + SOC2 answers?
sec-bot: Uploaded security questionnaire answers to the shared drive: https://redwood/link/eduplat-sec-qna — includes KMS integration notes, data residency, and suggested contract clauses.
Raj P: Blocker: their procurement needs a signed DPA + proof of SOC2; can we share SOC2 report this week?
Lisa M: Yes — legal confirmed we can share redacted SOC2. I'll attach in drive. Also need SSO registry details (SAML) for week1.
Zach L: On tool calling: they want access to a grading microservice (sync call) for rubric lookups. We support tool-calls; confirm outbound network egress policy for Private deployment.
Emma K: Good catch — for Private we can allow network egress via customer-managed NAT. For Hosted, we need to set up secure webhook with mTLS. Add to runbook.
Raj P: Timeline ok but customer asked if we can compress to 3 weeks if we cut scope (no cross-encoder rerank). Thoughts?
Zach L: Technically doable: start with embeddings-only pipeline + Gen model for responses. Cross-encoder can be optional follow-up. That saves ~1 week.
Lisa M: I'll offer both tracks in the SOW: Standard 4-week (emb+rerank) and Fast 3-week (emb-only). Include acceptance checklist per track.
Emma K: Ops questions: what perf baseline do we commit to on Dedicated? p95 <=200ms for gen seems tight for 64k. Maybe p95 <=600ms realistic unless we use larger GPU fleet.
Zach L: Agreed — propose p95 <=600ms for 64k context on Dedicated with GPU-pinned instances; for host they'd accept p95 <=1.2s. Document this in SOW.
Raj P: I'll prepare pricing scenarios: hosted per-token, dedicated monthly reserve with burst, and private with licensing + infra.
Emma K: Next actions: Lisa — draft prompt/eval set + SOW options; Zach — recommended infra + perf numbers and fallback routing policy; Raj — pricing scenarios and procurement checklist; I'll coordinate customer call Thursday.
Lisa M: On it.
Zach L: Will add example routing policy snippet: ```
if load_high then route -> smaller-context model or cached response
else route -> high-quality 64k model
```
sec-bot: Reminder: questionnaire signed by legal will take ~48h after DPA sent.
Emma K: Thanks — logging this as the thread's record. Will post calendar invite after Raj shares pricing by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
